risks.risk: Tyre size/fitment is unknown (price depends heavily on size like 215/60R16 vs larger sizes).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the tyre sidewall showing the full size code (e.g., 215/60R16) and DOT/brand markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case match among the comparables (assume it could be a lower-value size/unknown grade) and do not adjust upward until size is confirmed.

risks.risk: Tread depth claim (90%) may be overstated; visual tread alone can mislead.
risks.proof: Ask for a tread-depth measurement photo using a gauge (mm) at 3–4 points across the tyre.
risks.if_unproven: Treat as not guaranteed high tread; price at the lower end of the comparable range.

risks.risk: No patch/no bulge not fully verifiable; sidewall damage or internal repairs may exist.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of both sidewalls (full circumference) and the inner liner, plus a close-up of any repair/patch area if present.
risks.if_unproven: Assume possible defects not ruled out; price at the lower end until sidewall/inner condition is shown.

risks.risk: Brand/grade not readable; 'tokunbo' tyres vary widely in quality.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the brand name and model on the sidewall (and DOT code).
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic tokunbo used tyre without premium brand confirmation.

proof_requests: Send a clear sidewall photo showing the full tyre size code (e.g., 215/60R16) and brand/model text.
Send a photo of the DOT code (week/year) on the sidewall.
Send tread-depth measurements in mm (gauge) at 3–4 points across the tyre.
Send full sidewall photos (both sides) and a close-up of any repair/patch area; include inner liner if possible.
response.reason: The tyre is visible, but the key details that determine the correct market price (exact size/brand and confirmation of tread depth/repairs) are not readable or provable from the single photo.
